Definition
[asymptotic volume ratio definition] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 41.12\group Kleiner–Lott Kappa Solutions

For a complete $n$-manifold with nonnegative Ricci curvature, $\mathcal V=\lim _{r\to \infty }r^{-n}\vol (B(p,r))$ is the asymptotic volume ratio, independent of $p$.
